slices.focus: Caleb creates blunt weekly address-level status sheets breaking delays into three buckets (county approvals, homeowner documents, contractor hold-ups) to rebuild trust with corridor residents
slices.summary: Still doing damage control from the stalled files, Caleb builds a weekly status sheet that breaks each address's delays into three categories: county approvals, homeowner document problems, and contractor hold-ups. Handing these out during office hours shifts conversations from rumor to address-level reality, though the homeowner-document category requires careful handling to avoid defensiveness.
open_loops: Add last-updated date to movement sheets
Tighten wording on homeowner document categories to reduce defensiveness
Start logging resident reactions to measure transparency impact
